subject: Checked client initialization before invocation and metadata-only owner observation
source_of_truth: Existing released vuoro-client 0.1.1 handshake contract; actual VuoroOwner literal calls; immutable EC-01 agentops:vuoro-owner-port inventory
backends: existing live Vuoro profile, metadata GETs only
initial_state: No cached owner client or event loop
Historical inventory contains all 14 current literal calls

consistency.object: Owner client lifecycle and complete observation of declared call metadata

assumptions.isolation: One synchronous adapter thread owns each client/event loop; metadata reads do not create an atomic service snapshot

bounds.depth: examples with fault injection; no concurrency/model proof

invariants: No owner invocation before the existing client handshake succeeds
Failed initialization closes resources and never caches the failed client
Inspection performs only handshake/catalog reads and opens no execution dependencies
Every current declared owner call is represented; metadata equality never implies effective authority or execution acceptance
Reports omit credentials, profiles, endpoint/environment identity and arbitrary server error text
oracles: Released-client request log contains no POST after handshake refusal
Failed client HTTP transport and event loops are closed before retry
All 14 rows have explicit exact/missing/ambiguous/drift/unavailable status
Forbidden State/harness/password constructors fail the inspection test
Live HTTP guard permits exactly the two metadata GET routes
